guarantees.claim: For i in 0..3, prd_msbs[i] = in[(i*WidthPRDSBox)+8 +: (WidthPRDSBox-8)], i.e., bits 8 to WidthPRDSBox-1 of each WidthPRDSBox-sized input segment.

assumptions.claim: WidthPRDSBox must be greater than 8 to ensure legal array dimensions and positive part-select width.
assumptions.risk: If WidthPRDSBox <= 8, the return type [(WidthPRDSBox-8)-1:0] has a negative index and the part-select width is non-positive, causing a compilation/synthesis error.

uncertain_points.claim: WidthPRDSBox must be > 8; the function does not enforce this parameter constraint.
uncertain_points.risk: Illegal RTL leading to synthesis failure.
